title: Play LAN protocol software tests (v1.9.4)
clauseOfficialized: Snapshot replies are filtered for the requester, not the host notebook. crew.confidential and character sides stay scope-bound. eventAck records accepted events. Stale seq is ignored. Unknown senders are PLAY_LAN_UNKNOWN_PEER. After goodbye, further messages are PLAY_LAN_PEER_GONE. claimPhysicalE2e stays PLAY_LAN_PHYSICAL_E2E_UNCLAIMED.
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: Increment 2.14 officialized hello/heartbeat, duplicate seq, revoke, public-screen truth refusal, and hash/session mismatch, but not requester-filtered snapshot exchange, sides/confidential delivery, eventAck, unknown peer, or goodbye.
rowsStillOpen: Physical two-device LAN E2E / XD-010 (still blocked)
STUN/TURN, writable peer RPC, or positive RTC
